hooks.command: HOOK_ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -z "$HOOK_ROOT" ]; then HOOK_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi; AMQ_HOOK="$HOOK_ROOT/hooks/codex-prompt-observed.py"; if [ -n "$HOOK_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$AMQ_HOOK" ]; then /usr/bin/python3 "$AMQ_HOOK"; else /usr/bin/true; fi
